## Report format

End your final message with:

```sushi-report
{"outcome":"complete|partial|blocked","summary":"...","handoff":"...","decisions":[],"question":"","risk":[]}
```

`handoff` is for whoever continues this task if the attempt fails verification or review: what is done, what you tried that did not work, what to do next.
